faq.title: FAQ — Booking, Sessions & Investment
faq.description: Answers on booking timelines, what to wear, delivery, travel, retainers, and working with Haffu.

hero.title: Everything, Answered
hero.lede: If your question isn't here, Haffu answers within 60 seconds — any hour.

items.title: How far ahead should I book?
items.body: Most clients book 3–6 months ahead; weddings 6–12 months. Fall weekends go first — but ask, last-minute light happens.

items.title: What should we wear?
items.body: Every confirmed client receives a personalized style guide: soft neutrals, classic silhouettes, textures that photograph like film.

items.title: How do retainers work?
items.body: A reservation retainer (from $500) locks your date and is 100% credited to your collection. The remainder is due 48h before your session.

items.title: When do we see photos?
items.body: Sneak peek within 48 hours; the complete hand-graded gallery in 3–4 weeks — rush delivery available.

items.title: Do you travel?
items.body: Niagara wine country, Muskoka cottages, and GTA West destinations — boutique travel packages quoted up front.

items.title: Who is Haffu?
items.body: Hafsa's Creative Intelligence: it answers inquiries instantly, books discovery calls, and hands Hafsa every thread that needs her eye.
